title: Multidimensional analysis of immune-neuro-behavioral interactions in neuropsychiatric diseases (digital behavioral phenotyping, magnetic and electroencephalographic, MR tomographic and psychometric data collection and detailed immunological characterization) at the Department of General Psychiatry 2 - LVR-Klinikum Düsseldorf as well as at the Clinic for Neurology and the Institute for Clinical Neurosciences and Medical Psychology - University Hospital Düsseldorf
summary: To investigate the relationship between a disturbed social interaction and inflammation in neuropsychiatric diseases.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adult patients who are being treated on an outpatient or inpatient basis in the Department of General Psychiatry 2 at the LVR Clinic Düsseldorf due to an underlying psychiatric illness. The following patient groups should be included:
1. Patients with affective disorders (ICD-10 F3x e.g. depression, bipolar affective disorder)
2. Patients with neurotic, stress and somatoform disorders (ICD-10 F4x e.g. anxiety disorders, obsessive compulsive disorders)
3. Patients with schizophrenia, schizotypal and delusional disorders (ICD-10 F2x e.g. schizophrenia)
4. Patients with developmental disorders (ICD-10 F8x e.g. autism spectrum disorder)
5. Patients with behavioral and emotional disorders that began in childhood and adolescence (ICD-10 F9x, e.g. simple activity and attention disorder)

Adult patients with the following illnesses who are treated on an outpatient or inpatient basis in the Department of Neurology at the University Hospital Düsseldorf:
1. Patients with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS; ICD-10 G35.1x) and
2. patients with autoimmune encephalitis (AIE; ICD-10 G04.8)
as an immune-inflammatory control cohort and
3. patients with somatoform disorder (ICD-10 F45.x)
as a non-immune-inflammatory control cohort.
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion criteria:
• Pregnant or breastfeeding women
• People < 18 years of age
• Patients unable to give consent, with the exception of patients under legal guardianship, where the patient and guardian give informed consent.
• Patients with contraindications for MRI and MEG examinations, e.g. due to pacemaker implants
• Previous treatment with immunosuppressants, including chemotherapy, whole-body irradiation or bone marrow transplantation
• Treatment with high doses of steroids, immunoadsorption/plasmapheresis or immunoglobulins within 3 months prior to sampling
• Ongoing treatment with immunosuppressants including chemotherapy, steroids, immunoadsorption/plasmapheresis, immunoglobulins or whole-body irradiation at the time of sampling
• Patients with other systemic inflammatory diseases (e.g. systemic lupus erythematosus, systemic vasculitis)
• Patients with immune deficiencies
• Obvious signs of a systemic infection or known acute or chronic infectious diseases (e.g. HIV, HBV/HCV, TB)
• History of drug use in the last 14 days prior to examination (drug urine test in urine is routinely performed as part of psychiatric treatment and thus before inclusion)
